pinyin: Tiān xià yǒu dào， què zǒu mǎ yǐ fèn。
Tiān xià wú dào， róng mǎ shēng yú jiāo。
Huò mò dà yú bù zhī zú；
Jiù mò dà yú yù dé。
Gù zhī zú zhī zú， cháng zú yǐ。
english: When the world follows the Tao, horses run free to fertilize the fields. When the world does not follow the Tao, war horses are bred outside the cities.
There is no greater transgression than condoning people's selfish desires, no greater disaster than being discontent, and no greater retribution than for greed.
Whoever knows contentment will be at peace forever.
